case_reports.text: Suspect Ravi Malhotra met with Suresh Nair near Andheri Warehouse at 22:00. A white Toyota Innova bearing plate MH12AB1234 was seen at the location. Ravi Malhotra was contacted from phone number +91-9876543210.
Suresh Nair transferred funds to an account linked to Global Traders Pvt Ltd. Vehicle MH12AB1234 was again spotted outside Global Traders Pvt Ltd office in Andheri.
Call log: +91-9876543210 called +91-9123456789 (registered to Suresh Nair) for 14 minutes at 23:10.
Suspicious cash deposit of INR 950000 made by Suresh Nair at branch near Andheri. Structuring pattern flagged: deposit split into three transactions under reporting threshold.

Informant reports Ravi Malhotra coordinates a group including Suresh Nair, Ajay Kulkarni, and Deepak Shah. Ajay Kulkarni owns Global Traders Pvt Ltd. Deepak Shah supplies vehicles including Toyota Innova MH12AB1234.
Call log: +91-9876543210 called +91-9988776655 (registered to Deepak Shah) for 3 minutes.
Ajay Kulkarni and Deepak Shah observed at Global Traders Pvt Ltd office at 19:30. Vehicle MH14CD5678 registered to Ajay Kulkarni parked outside.
Global Traders Pvt Ltd account received wire transfer from Deepak Shah. Same day, a cash withdrawal was made by Ravi Malhotra at an ATM near Andheri Warehouse.
Burst calling pattern detected: +91-9876543210 made 18 calls within 2 hours to +91-9123456789, +91-9988776655, and +91-9871234567 (unregistered).
Unregistered number +91-9871234567 believed to belong to new associate Vikram Rao, recently seen with Ravi Malhotra at Andheri Warehouse.
